name: Thomas Built Buses Manufacturing Plant - High Point NC

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (ROOFTOP, moved 30m) landed on the legacy Thomas Built Buses plant. Confirmed via Thomas Built Buses / DTNA news pages - 1408 Courtesy Road, High Point NC, the company's original site since 1916, building Type A Minotour / Type C / Type D school buses (Minotour capacity expansion announced Dec 2025).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Sprawling legacy urban industrial complex straddling Courtesy Road; buildings line both sides of the public street. Individual yards are fenced (privacy-slat chain-link seen in Street View) but there is no single dominant manned perimeter gate or barrier arm controlling all truck traffic - access is from the public road into multiple fenced yards. truckGate set false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified at any frontage in Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed at docks across several buildings; estimate 25-50 doors total, flagged uncertain (legacy multi-building layout, several faces obscured).
fieldNotes.dropArea: School buses and some trailers staged in lots along the rail side; banded 10-25, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No single dedicated trailer-storage lot - finished buses and trailers staged in working yards.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple active rail spurs run into the property along the NE-SW rail corridor.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Legacy campus of many connected/adjacent buildings straddling Courtesy Road = a multi-building complex.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Plant fronts directly on a narrow public street (Courtesy Road) with little stacking room; a truck queue at any yard entrance would spill onto the road.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity is spread across separate buildings/faces handling different inbound and outbound flows.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Yard approaches off Courtesy Road are short (1-2 trucks).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense urban industrial fabric of High Point - Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified - flagged uncertain.
